scope: Read-only static review of packaging and cleanup scripts. Not execution, not final package acceptance.
verifiedGuards: Packager requires exact136 slots, built-in native source >=1024, hash agreement and distinct native/pixel sources; no mirrored output matches.
Acceptance must bind exact snapshot manifest and each direction must independently pass specified checks; packaging cannot self-approve.
16-frame deep/light GIFs required with30ms durations and480ms cycle; final output asset bytes copied and checked.
Text provenance copied byte-for-byte with old absolute paths explicitly historical and a portable evidence mapping.
Cleanup plan generated only from character09 generation/processing directories; external current portrait, approved designs, other characters, host image cache and final package excluded.

Cleanup verifies entire listed final checksums then each exact deletion target's resolved boundary, regular-file type, no reparse ancestor, bytes and SHA; final subtree rejected; no recursive broad delete.
operationalRequirements: Root must confirm no active generation still references the planned removed originals; cleanup script does not inspect active processes.
After cleanup, changed README/retention metadata requires checksum refresh. Newly created cleanup logs are not in the original package-checksums index.
